title: CI still runs the tests, and ci-ok still needs them
assertion: In .github/workflows/swerepo-ci.yml, a test job, and a test-<project> job for every folder in .swerepo.toml's [projects] listed, each runs `uv run pytest`, is not switched off (if: false) and not allowed to fail (continue-on-error: true) at job or step level, and isn't masked (|| or ;, &, --version, --help, --collect-only). ci-ok's needs names each of them, and ci-ok still fails when one fails: it runs if: always(), isn't allowed to fail, and has a step that reads the jobs' results (NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}) and can exit non-zero.

origin.text: SWERepo's hygiene rule pack (spec §6.8, ADR-20261124-cd64): seamspec/hygiene-ci-tests@1.
